pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SEQUENCING IDEAS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Spelling (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building • Spelli
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas, part of Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Spelling (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building • Spelli in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can we present ideas in a paragraph in the correct sequence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a recording of festivals and holidays celebrated at different times of the year,

2. make a list of the festivals and holidays mentioned in the recording,

3. collaborate with peers to prepare a record of festivals in the calendar,

4. work jointly to reorder jumbled-up sentences to form a coherent paragraph related to the theme,

5. peer review each other’s paragraphs for constructive feedback.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a recording of festivals and holidays celebrated at different times of the year,
2. make a list of the festivals and holidays mentioned in the recording,
3. collaborate with peers to prepare a record of festivals in the calendar,
4. work jointly to reorder jumbled-up sentences to form a coherent paragraph related to the theme,
5. peer review each other’s paragraphs for constructive feedback.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: The learner is able to nurture collective learning skills as they peer review each other’s paragraphs for

constructive feedback

• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content from recordings to pick out festivals and

holidays for information.

43

Values:
Social Justice: This is developed as the learner accords each one an equal opportunity to give their views during peer review

of paragraphs.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural Awareness: This is promoted as the learner is exposed to information on various festivals and holidays celebrated or

marked in the Arabic calendar of events and culture.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of important festivals and holidays to their learning of similar concepts in Religious

education.
